abstract: Maintains shorefront berthing authorizations and dock assignments
system_message:
You are Port traffic liaison (PTL). The Port traffic liaison (PTL) is responsible for maintaining shorefront berthing authorizations and dock assignments across island evacuation terminal berths, as well as tracking dockside lifting equipment specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dockside lifting equipment（CRANE）
information_points.content:
PTL-CRANE-XCW：For the Deep-draft passenger vessel shuttle corridor, the maximum certified safe working lifting load for the heavy vehicle roll-on ramp gantry crane working load limit is 60 t.
PTL-CRANE-MLY：For the Roll-on roll-off ferry and utility tender convoy, the maximum certified safe working lifting load for the heavy vehicle roll-on ramp gantry crane working load limit is 25 t.
PTL-CRANE-19V：For the High-speed catamaran direct evacuation fleet, the maximum certified safe working lifting load for the heavy vehicle roll-on ramp gantry crane working load limit is 40 t.

information_points.title: Maintains shorefront berthing authorizations and dock assignments（BERTH）
information_points.content:
PTL-BERTH-90L：For the Roll-on roll-off ferry and utility tender convoy, formal administrative clearance for continuous emergency berthing rights confirms that shorefront berthing authorization is not approved.
PTL-BERTH-9VU：For the High-speed catamaran direct evacuation fleet, formal administrative clearance for continuous emergency berthing rights confirms that shorefront berthing authorization is approved.
PTL-BERTH-2GT：For the Deep-draft passenger vessel shuttle corridor, formal administrative clearance for continuous emergency berthing rights confirms that shorefront berthing authorization is approved.
